total_model.summary: Model projects 41.5 total points (KC 25, LAC 17). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 2.3), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 2.1), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (lowers total 0.9). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
